title: DataRecoverability
description: ISO 25012-sourced data quality archetype — Recoverability system-dependent data quality characteristic. The degree to which data has attributes that enable it to maintain and preserve a specified level of operations and quality, even in the event of failure, in a specific context of use. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms governing data entities. Source: ISO/IEC 25012 (System-Dependent Data Quality — Recoverability).

recoveryPointObjective.description: Maximum acceptable data loss measured in time. ISO 8601 duration (e.g., PT0S for zero data loss, PT1H for 1-hour RPO).

recoveryTimeObjective.description: Maximum acceptable time to restore data access after failure. ISO 8601 duration.

backupStrategy.description: Data backup strategy. NONE = no backup. PERIODIC_SNAPSHOT = scheduled full backups. INCREMENTAL = differential changes captured. CONTINUOUS_REPLICATION = real-time data replication.
